meta.range: 2026-09-19 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (data exists from 2026-09-19 10:52 UTC; PostHog was installed that day)
meta.human_filter: sessions with >=1 $pageview, no event with $virt_is_bot = true, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app (unless a query says otherwise)
meta.caveat: Test-account cohort 580233 has 0 members, so team traffic is included (about 48 sessions from 4 devices with 10+ sessions each, Q24). Aggregates only.

queries.what: Session funnel by source group and first device (bots excluded; internal shown as its own group). A step counts if it happened anywhere in the session, so steps need not be in order.
queries.hogql: SELECT src_group, device, count() AS sessions, countIf(product_pv > 0) AS s1_product, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS s2_store, countIf(form_started > 0) AS s3_form_started, countIf(submit > 0) AS s4_valid_submit, countIf(checkout > 0) AS s5_order_created, countIf(dismissed > 0) AS sheet_closed, countIf(purchased > 0) AS s6_purchase FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') AS us, coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') AS um, coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') AS fbc, multiIf( ref IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR ref LIKE '%vercel.app', 'Internal (local or preview)', um = 'paid', 'Paid social, tagged', fbc != '' AND us = '', 'Meta click id, no UTM', um = 'social', 'Instagram bio link (ig/social)', us = 'chatgpt.com' OR ref = 'chatgpt.com', 'ChatGPT', ref IN ('www.google.com','www.bing.com','duckduckgo.com','au.search.yahoo.com','com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'), 'Organic search', ref IN ('l.facebook.com','m.facebook.com','www.facebook.com','instagram.com','l.instagram.com','www.threads.com','www.linkedin.com','com.twitter.android'), 'Organic social, other', ref IN ('kheelona.com','www.kheelona.com'), 'Own site (session restarted)', ref = '$direct' OR ref IS NULL, 'Direct', 'Referral') AS src_group, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/products/kheelu%') AS product_pv, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'preorder_start') AS submit, countIf(event = 'begin_checkout') AS checkout, countIf(event = 'preorder_dismissed') AS dismissed, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','preorder_start','begin_checkout','preorder_dismissed','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 ) GROUP BY ROLLUP(src_group, device) ORDER BY src_group, device

queries.what: Session funnel by first device, internal sessions excluded, with duration and single-page share
queries.hogql: SELECT device, count() AS sessions, countIf(product_pv > 0) AS s1_product, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS s2_store, countIf(form_started > 0) AS s3_form_started, countIf(submit > 0) AS s4_valid_submit, countIf(checkout > 0) AS s5_order_created, countIf(dismissed > 0) AS sheet_closed, countIf(purchased > 0) AS s6_purchase, round(avg(dur),0) AS avg_duration_s, round(quantile(0.5)(dur),0) AS median_duration_s, round(avg(pvs),2) AS avg_pageviews, round(100*countIf(pvs = 1)/count(),1) AS pct_single_page FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, any(session.$session_duration) AS dur, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/products/kheelu%') AS product_pv, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'preorder_start') AS submit, countIf(event = 'begin_checkout') AS checkout, countIf(event = 'preorder_dismissed') AS dismissed, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','preorder_start','begin_checkout','preorder_dismissed','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY ROLLUP(device) ORDER BY sessions DESC

queries.what: PostHog's native ordered funnel (persons, 14-day window, bots excluded, internal NOT excluded), by device. Saved as insight Y9KjojeN.
Form submits rejected by client validation (an autocaptured form submit with no preorder_start)
queries.hogql: SELECT device, in_app, count() AS sessions_with_submit, countIf(starts = 0) AS submit_never_valid, countIf(submits > starts AND starts > 0) AS some_submits_invalid, sum(submits) AS submit_events, sum(starts) AS valid_submits, countIf(checkouts > 0) AS order_created, countIf(purchased > 0) AS purchased, countIf(dismissed > 0) AS sheet_closed FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, coalesce(argMin(properties.$webview_app, timestamp),'') AS in_app, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, countIf(event = '$autocapture' AND properties.$event_type = 'submit' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com') AS submits, countIf(event = 'preorder_start') AS starts, countIf(event = 'begin_checkout') AS checkouts, countIf(event = 'preorder_dismissed') AS dismissed, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$autocapture','preorder_start','begin_checkout','preorder_dismissed','purchase','$pageview') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING submits > 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY ROLLUP(device, in_app)

SELECT event, count() AS n, sum(toFloat(properties.value)) AS value_inr_sum, groupUniqArray(properties.tier) AS tiers, countIf(coalesce(properties.utm_source,'') != '') AS with_utm_source, groupUniqArray(coalesce(properties.utm_source,'')) AS utm_sources, countIf(properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_session_id FROM events WHERE event IN ('purchase','purchase_confirmed') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY event

queries.what: Sessions per purchasing device (aggregate of the 2 purchasing devices)
queries.hogql: SELECT distinct_id IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase' AND <window>) AS is_purchaser_device, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions, min(toDate(timestamp)) AS first_seen, countIf(properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com') AS store_pageviews FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND <window> AND distinct_id IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase' AND <window>) GROUP BY distinct_id

queries.what: Seconds from the last tap on a store link on kheelona.com to the first store $pageview in the same session (proxy for store load plus SDK start; gaps over 300 s dropped)
queries.hogql: SELECT device, count() AS hops, round(quantile(0.5)(gap_ms)/1000, 1) AS median_s, round(quantile(0.75)(gap_ms)/1000, 1) AS p75_s, round(quantile(0.9)(gap_ms)/1000, 1) AS p90_s, max(gap_ms)/1000 AS max_s FROM ( SELECT sid, device, dateDiff('millisecond', click_ts, store_ts) AS gap_ms FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, maxIf(timestamp, event = '$autocapture' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%') AS click_ts, minIf(timestamp, event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com') AS store_ts, countIf(event = '$autocapture' AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%') AS n_clicks, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com') AS n_store FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$autocapture','$pageview') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING n_clicks > 0 AND n_store > 0 ) WHERE store_ts > click_ts AND dateDiff('second', click_ts, store_ts) < 300 ) GROUP BY ROLLUP(device)
